description: This file defines the MainViewModel class for an Android app. It manages authentication state, handles user actions such as login, lock, unlock, calling protected APIs, and logout. It also observes the authentication state via AuthManager and updates UI state accordingly. The file includes interactions with networking components (ApiClient), authentication models, and coroutine flows for state management.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing authentication state, user actions, and UI state for the main interface.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login and updates auth state.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the session after biometric verification.

methods.name: callProtected
methods.description: Calls a protected API endpoint using the API client.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and clears tokens.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears the status log displayed in the UI.
